description: Metadata for exactly one book: title, author, genre, chapter count, word count, source URL and every access URL (HTML page, Markdown mirror, first chapter). When to use: you have a lang+slug and need to decide whether the book is worth fetching, or you need chapter_count before pulling a specific chapter. Do not use: to read content (call cyberlibrary_get_chapter or cyberlibrary_get_markdown). Returns: one catalog record object.

slug.description: Book slug from the catalog, e.g. 23825.

name: cyberlibrary_book_meta
